name: TeamStarWolf - Boston Scientific Network Outage August 2026 Case Study
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. Enterprise ATT&CK v20.0 techniques bound in the Boston Scientific network outage case study: an unauthorized third party entered through an external-facing network management device on or before 25 August 2026 and reached a limited portion of the on-premises IT environment (CrowdStrike investigation summary, 22 September 2026). The record states the entry point but not the method, so both Initial Access techniques are candidates at score 40 and neither is asserted. Score 40: a candidate the record allows but does not state. Scores measure the strength of the tie to this record, not severity. No actor, malware, CVE, encryption or exfiltration is in the record, so none is bound. Comments carry the study's source numbers.
